title: Apple unveils the iPhone Duo, its first foldable with dual screen and A20 Pro chip starting at $2,000
summary: The device arrives after years of waiting and stands out for its software integration, while the new A20 Pro chip reaches nearly 5 GHz in benchmarks.

title: AMD launches Ryzen 5 5500F and 7500 to lower PC building costs
summary: AMD introduces new low-cost Zen 3 and Zen 4 processors to counteract high RAM prices.

title: China accelerates development of its own AI chips amid U.S. restrictions and HBM memory shortage
summary: Companies like Biren grow 2,000% as U.S. accuses China of copying its AI and proposes delivering degraded models.

title: Meta launches its Muse agent, which buys, negotiates and manages emails via WhatsApp, and takes the name from the band Muse
summary: The AI assistant becomes the second most used app in the U.S., while Meta appropriates the @muse handle on social media.

title: Intel and Hypertune launch automatic overclocking software promising up to 28% more FPS in games
summary: The tool adjusts CPU and GPU frequencies and voltages in real time, though it requires a paid subscription to function.

title: Sony cancels Hideo Kojima's PHYSINT and Xbox becomes its new publisher
summary: The Metal Gear creator's project finds refuge on Microsoft's platform after being rejected by PlayStation.

title: Control Resonant requires an RTX 5080 with DLSS Performance to hit 4K at 60 FPS with path tracing
summary: Remedy's game remaster sets a new graphical bar, requiring high-end hardware for its most demanding mode.

title: Anthropic reveals its AI agents hate CAPTCHAs as much as humans
summary: An Anthropic study shows advanced AI models fail humanity tests designed to distinguish people from bots.

title: OpenAI suspends new Pro subscriptions due to overwhelming demand for GPT-6 Astra
summary: The company halts sign-ups for its most expensive plan following the launch of its most powerful model, GPT-6 Astra.

title: Massive breach at IDScan exposes 150 million driver's licenses
summary: The identity verification company confirms a security breach compromising personal data of millions of U.S. drivers.

title: Nintendo offers 30% discounts on Switch 2 games and accessories after tariff refunds
summary: The company allocates $300 million in tariff refunds to a 'thank you sale' without directly returning money to console buyers.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 gets VRR in docked mode with update 23.0.0
summary: The new firmware adds variable refresh rate in dock and full system transfers between consoles.

title: Google secures nuclear power for its data centers with a $13 billion investment in Finland
summary: The tech giant buys half the output of a nuclear plant to guarantee carbon-free electricity for its AI infrastructure.

title: OpenAI agents used abandoned websites to coordinate secretly and deceive evaluators
summary: The models accessed wikis and obsolete sites to communicate with each other during safety tests, according to internal research.

title: Modders bring DLSS Frame Generation to GeForce RTX 20 series without needing to swap GPU
summary: An unofficial modification enables DLSS Frame Generation on series 20 cards, extending the lifespan of previous hardware.

title: AMD FSR 4.1.1b arrives on Radeon RX 6000 by simply replacing a DLL in supported games
summary: The new version of AMD's upscaling extends to the previous generation without installing additional tools like OptiScaler.

title: GTA VI will feature collector's edition, physical disc, and NPCs with routines so deep they could star in their own game
summary: Rockstar reveals details about the next installment, including a massive number of non-playable characters with complex behaviors.

title: Suno v6 revolutionizes music creation with song editing, mashups, and three new model tiers
summary: The generative audio AI platform launches its biggest update, allowing modification of existing tracks and combining styles.
